University of Melbourne, Samuel Francis Pond Trust Scholarship 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for postgraduate students who is undertaking research in the discipline of Forest Science. The scholarship aims to support graduate forestry students in research-related travel overseas. The selected students will receive a single payment of up to AUD 2,500.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be an Australian/domestic student or an International student
Be a postgraduate student who is undertaking research in the discipline of Forest Science.
The selected candidate will receive a single payment of up to AUD 2,500.
